S0131.reason: Consent to an unarmed fistfight does not cover a blow with brass knuckles, so the weapon exceeded the scope of consent even though the injury happened to be the same.

S0004.reason: A stoma should pass through the rectus abdominis within the rectus sheath; the umbilicus, skin creases, and the incision are sites to avoid.

S1333.reason: Before the UN Charter, resort to armed force was generally a sovereign right, limited only by narrow rules such as the League Covenant and the Kellogg-Briand Pact.
